label: Placebo
rationale: This randomized, double-blind trial explicitly includes a placebo comparator. The blinded 39-week treatment phase has a placebo arm, and two active-dose arms also include matched placebo tablets, so placebo use is part of the study design.

evidence.quote: Placebo-controlled Phase II/III Adaptive Clinical Study
Researchers will compare drug CB03-154 to a placebo
Participants will receive Placebo 15mg orally once daily for 39 weeks.
Participants will receive CB03-154 5mg and Placebo 10mg orally once daily for 39 weeks.

title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Different Doses of CB03-154 in Adult Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
